snippet.title: Star Fleet Deluxe | Trailer [GOG]
snippet.description:

Facebook: 👉  https://bit.ly/2NWKVCw

Star Fleet Deluxe (SFD) is a strategic space war game. At the helm of a United Galactic Alliance (UGA) Invincible class heavy cruiser, you are tasked with defending the UGA colonies against advancing Krellan forces, and driving them out within a given time. Though the task is formidable, you are not completely alone. The surviving UGA starbases and outposts on unconquered planets will assist you in providing shelter in orbit, resupplying your cruiser, and providing real-time updates on Krellan movement.

Though the concept of a timed space defense war simulation may seem simple on paper there is much depth to Star Fleet Deluxe. Missions are randomly generated with Krellan battlecruisers, supply ships, and destroyers programmed to support one another in their invasion. Though they can be unpredictable, they maintain the same mission: conquer planets, attack UGA starbases, and ambush your cruiser at every turn.
